name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-content-lifecycle
title: Content Lifecycle Management
shortDescription: Manages SharePoint document retention, archiving, version cleanup, and expiry review through Copilot.
longDescription: Helps Copilot manage the full content lifecycle for SharePoint documents: apply and view retention labels, identify and archive old content, reduce excessive version history counts, and review expired content.
Safe by design — always previews before acting, double-confirms deletions, and guides users to the settings UI for irreversible operations like version deletion.
